sample_points_from_depth: sample 3D points along backprojected rays from a depth image batch using Sensor.sample_points
get_digit_frame_data: get tactile sensor frame data with predicted depth from a DigitSensor using get_frame_data
get_realsense_frame_data: get RGB-D frame data with SAM segmentation from a RealsenseSensor using get_frame_data
undistort_depth_image: undistort a depth image using camera intrinsics and distortion coefficients with undistort_depth
filter_depth_outliers: filter depth map outliers using percentile-based thresholding with filter_depth
